fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: A mote of fire hurled at a creature or object within range.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature; it ignores half cover.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains hit points. (The casting-ability bonus is added by the engine at cast time.)

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Three glowing darts of magical force strike unerringly; each dart deals 1d4+1 force damage.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A creature you can see regains hit points. Cast as a bonus action; treated as an action until the bonus-action economy lands.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.description: Protective magical force surrounds the target: base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier until it dons armor or the spell is dismissed.
mage_armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Creatures fall unconscious. Simplified: a single WIS save or be incapacitated; the two-stage unconscious ladder and waking on damage are not modeled.
sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand)

chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
chill_touch.description: Channeling the chill of the grave, you touch a creature: melee spell attack for 1d10 necrotic damage, and on a hit it can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.description: A beam of crackling energy: ranged spell attack for 1d10 force damage. (SRD: two beams at level 5+ — cantrip scaling is not modeled.)

produce_flame.name: Produce Flame
produce_flame.description: A flame appears in your hand and you hurl it: ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire damage. (SRD: bonus action to create the flame, then an action to hurl it — collapsed to a single bonus-action attack.)

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light: ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage. (The 10-foot speed reduction is GM-adjudicated.)

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand: melee spell attack for 1d8 lightning damage. (The 'can't take opportunity attacks' rider is GM-adjudicated.)

starry_wisp.name: Starry Wisp
starry_wisp.description: A mote of light streaks toward a creature: ranged spell attack for 1d8 radiant damage. (The dim-light and can't-benefit-from-invisibility riders are GM-adjudicated.)

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments: the target makes a WIS save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn. (SRD limits the disadvantage to the target's next attack roll — not modeled.)

charm_person.name: Charm Person
charm_person.description: One humanoid makes a WIS save or has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or you damage it. (Charmed is GM-adjudicated; the status is combat-scoped and clears at combat end, and the save-with-advantage-if-fighting rule is not modeled.)

chromatic_orb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromatic_orb.description: You hurl an orb of acid: ranged spell attack for 3d8 acid damage. (SRD lets you choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder at cast time — the type is fixed here; the 50 GP diamond component and the orb's leap are not modeled.)
chromatic_orb.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50+ GP)

command.name: Command
command.description: You speak a one-word command; on a failed WIS save the target falls prone (the Grovel command). (The Approach/Drop/Flee/Halt/Heel commands and choosing among them are GM-adjudicated.)

dissonant_whispers.name: Dissonant Whispers
dissonant_whispers.description: A discordant melody echoes in the target's mind: WIS save or 3d6 psychic damage, half on success. (The forced-move reaction rider is GM-adjudicated.)

faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie_fire.description: Creatures in a 20-foot cube are outlined in light (simplified to a single target): DEX save or attack rolls against it have advantage while you concentrate.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: You hurl a bolt of light: ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage, and on a hit mystical light marks the target — attack rolls against it have advantage until the end of your next turn. (SRD limits the advantage to the next attack roll — not modeled.)

hideous_laughter.name: Hideous Laughter
hideous_laughter.description: A creature hears a hideous melody: WIS save or it is incapacitated with laughter while you concentrate. (SRD also applies prone and lets the target repeat the save each turn — simplified to a single save, matching Sleep.)
hideous_laughter.components: V, S, M (a tart and a feather)

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.description: Necrotic energy ravages a creature you touch: CON save or 2d10 necrotic damage, half on success. (SRD 5.2.1: a save, not an attack roll.)

ray_of_sickness.name: Ray of Sickness
ray_of_sickness.description: A greenish ray: ranged spell attack for 2d8 poison damage, and on a hit the target is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.description: The target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance: base AC becomes 17. (The 'if its AC is lower' floor is not modeled — the effect replaces the base AC, like Mage Armor; a long rest ends it.)
barkskin.components: V, S, M (a handful of bark)

blindness_deafness.name: Blindness/Deafness
blindness_deafness.description: One creature makes a CON save or is blinded for the duration. (The deafened variant and the end-of-turn repeat saves are not modeled.)

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Your body becomes blurred: attack rolls against you have disadvantage while you concentrate.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.description: A humanoid makes a WIS save or is paralyzed while you concentrate. (The end-of-turn repeat save is not modeled — paralysis lasts until concentration breaks or the duration lapses.)
hold_person.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible while you concentrate: attack rolls against it have disadvantage and its own have advantage. (SRD ends the spell when the target attacks, deals damage, or casts — not modeled, so the target attacks with advantage for the whole duration; self/ally-targeted concentration spells are combat-only.)
invisibility.components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)

mind_spike.name: Mind Spike
mind_spike.description: You drive a spike of psionic energy into a creature's mind: WIS save or 3d8 psychic damage, half on success. (The always-know-the-target's-location rider is GM-adjudicated.)

acid_splash.name: Acid Splash
acid_splash.description: An acidic bubble explodes at a point: creatures in a 5-foot sphere make a DEX save or take 1d6 acid damage. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — the target plus everything engaged with it, friend or foe; cantrip scaling not modeled.)

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: A sheet of flame shoots from you: creatures in a 15-foot cone make a DEX save, taking 3d6 fire damage, half on success. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — everyone engaged with you, friend or foe; upcasting not modeled.)

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Grasping plants sprout in a 20-foot square: creatures make a STR save or are restrained while you concentrate. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — the target plus everything engaged with it; difficult terrain and the escape Athletics check are not modeled — restraint lasts until concentration breaks or the duration lapses.)

grease.name: Grease
grease.description: Slick grease covers a 10-foot square: creatures standing in it make a DEX save or fall prone. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — the target plus everything engaged with it; difficult terrain and the enter/end-of-turn repeat saves are not modeled.)
grease.components: V, S, M (a bit of pork rind or butter)

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: A loud noise erupts at a point: creatures in a 10-foot sphere make a CON save, taking 3d8 thunder damage, half on success. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — the target plus everything engaged with it; the construct's disadvantage on the save and upcasting are not modeled.)
shatter.components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you: creatures in a 15-foot cube make a CON save, taking 2d8 thunder damage, half on success. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — everyone engaged with you, friend or foe; the 10-foot push and upcasting are not modeled.)

web.name: Web
web.description: Sticky webbing fills a 20-foot cube: creatures make a DEX save or are restrained while you concentrate. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — the target plus everything engaged with it; difficult terrain, light obscurement, the escape Athletics check, and flammability are not modeled — restraint lasts until concentration breaks or the duration lapses.)
web.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)

poison_spray.name: Poison Spray
poison_spray.description: You spray toxic mist at a creature: ranged spell attack for 1d12 poison damage. (Cantrip scaling not modeled.)

sorcerous_burst.name: Sorcerous Burst
sorcerous_burst.description: You cast sorcerous energy at a creature: ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage of a type you choose. (Type choice collapsed to fire; the reroll-on-8 rider is not modeled.)

animal_friendship.name: Animal Friendship
animal_friendship.description: A beast you can see makes a WIS save or is charmed by you. (The beast-only target restriction is GM-adjudicated; the 24-hour duration is combat-scoped like other statuses.)
animal_friendship.components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)

color_spray.name: Color Spray
color_spray.description: Flashing light bursts from you: creatures in a 15-foot cone make a CON save or are blinded until the end of your next turn. (Area resolved by engagement cluster — everyone engaged with you, friend or foe.)
color_spray.components: V, S, M (a pinch of colorful sand)

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. (The choice collapses to curing all matching active conditions.)

protection_from_poison.name: Protection from Poison
protection_from_poison.description: You touch a creature, ending the poisoned condition on it and warding it with resistance to poison damage. (Advantage on saves against poison is GM-adjudicated; the 1-hour duration is combat-scoped like other statuses.)
